9002: Get into a plank on your hands or forearms with your body in a line.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Keep your hips level and do not twist.
9009: Lie face down over the ball with your hands on the floor.
Let your legs hang down with your toes light on the floor.
Squeeze your glutes and raise both legs until they are in line with your body.
Keep your hands planted and your core tight.
9010: Sit on the ball and roll down until your lower back is supported.
Hold the medicine ball against your chest or overhead.
Brace your core and crunch your ribs toward your hips.
Lower back over the ball with control.
Keep your feet firmly on the floor.
9024: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and your legs slightly off the floor.
Scissor your legs up and down in alternating motion.
Crunch your ribs toward your hips.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for a set count of reps.
9025: Sit tall on the ball with your feet wide.
Hold the weight or handle high on one side.
Rotate and chop diagonally down to the opposite hip.
Keep your arms mostly straight and your hips steady.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.
9040: Place your hands on a wall and lean forward with a straight body line.
Drive one knee up while the other leg stays extended.
Switch legs quickly in a running rhythm.
Go hard for 10-20 seconds, then rest.
9041: Set a low platform under the smith bar and put your front foot on it.
Place the bar across your upper back and unrack it.
Step the back foot behind you.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through the front heel to stand.
Do all reps, then switch legs.
9042: Place a bench behind the smith machine and rest your back foot on it.
Position the bar on your upper back and unrack it.
Lower your hips until the front thigh is near parallel.
Drive up through the front foot.
Complete the reps, then switch legs.
9043: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
Pull your shoulder blades down and tuck your knees to your chest.
Lean back and raise your hips until your back is horizontal.
9044: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms.
Lift your body to horizontal in a tucked position.
Open your hips slightly so your back is flat.
Keep your shoulder blades pulled down.
9045: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
Pull your shoulder blades down and tighten your core.
Raise your whole body to horizontal with your legs straight.
Keep your arms locked and your body in one line.
Hold for as long as you can with good form.
9047: Lie on your back with one heel on the ball and the other leg raised.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line.
Curl the ball toward your glutes with the one leg.
Extend the leg slowly back out.
Finish the reps and switch legs.
9048: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Drive one knee across your body toward the opposite elbow.
Return the foot and switch legs quickly.
Keep your hips low and level.
Keep up a steady pace for a set time.
9049: Lie on an incline bench and hold the top edge behind your head.
Bring your legs up so your knees are over your hips.
Curl your pelvis up to lift your hips off the bench.
Keep the movement small and controlled.
9066: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hop back to the start, then hop to each side.
Hold each landing for a moment.
Keep your chest up and your knee over your foot.
Repeat the pattern, then switch legs.
9068: Stand at the edge of a low box.
Land on both feet at the same time.
Bend your hips and knees to absorb the impact.
Hold the landing for a second.
9070: Stand tall with your knees nearly straight.
Hop off the balls of your feet.
Keep your heels off the ground.
Bounce quickly with minimal knee bend.
Stay light and quiet on landing.
Go for a set time or number of hops.
